--SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--
--CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_CRM] AS
--BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS AS (
SELECT 
	BCC.ORGKEY as CustomerID
	,TMDATE as PeriodStartDate
	,convert(date,NULL) as PeriodEndDate
	,BCC.MARITAL_STATUS as MaritalStatusID
	,NULL as CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCC
	WHERE  BCC.isLatest = '1'
)
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerID), 
		convert(char,MaritalStatusID))) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
)
--SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC
,
--WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerID), 
		convert(char,MaritalStatusID))) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus_CM201_20231219
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' 
	AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
--SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT;

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
		 ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
     	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
		,CASE
			 WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, RECORD_STATUS FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA
--GROUP BY RECORD_STATUS;

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus_CM201_20231219 TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID 
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
 AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE  TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;


-----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus_CM201_20231219 (
	[CustomerId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[MaritalStatusId]
	,[CustomerMaritalStatusNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

--WITH SELECT_CNT AS (
SELECT  DISTINCT   
	SRC.CustomerId
    ,SRC.PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate
    ,SRC.MaritalStatusId
    ,SRC.CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');
--)
--SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SELECT_CNT

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;

--END
--GO
